approach: Keep the disposable target branch at a clean pre-task baseline. The first task makes only the Shohin manifest schema edit and runs the precommitted targeted gate fixture. The second task creates only the node:test manifest regression and depends on the first task.

phases.name: Target Manifest Boundary
phases.goal: Make the smallest manifest schema change, then add the smallest regression proving it.

tasks.title: Add closed Shohin storage sqlitePath config
tasks.failing_test: The precommitted targeted gate fixture reads the baseline Shohin manifest and exits nonzero because configSchema.properties.storage is absent. Run `node --test docs/plans/shohin-spike-target/reviews/t001-storage-sqlite-path-gate.mjs` before the manifest edit and record the nonzero exit.
tasks.change:
**File:** `plugins/shohin/openclaw.plugin.json`

Add `storage` under `configSchema.properties` as `{ "type": "object", "additionalProperties": false, "properties": { "sqlitePath": { "type": "string" } } }`. Leave the existing `enabled` property and top-level closed config schema intact. Do not edit any other product file.
tasks.allowed_moves: Manifest-only edit. Do not add the node:test regression in this task. Do not touch target plan artifacts except for normal WAI gate bookkeeping.
tasks.stop_triggers: Stop if the gate fixture is not red before the manifest edit, if the manifest edit touches any path other than `plugins/shohin/openclaw.plugin.json`, or if the fixture is not green after the intended edit.
tasks.manual_verification: Run the targeted fixture before and after the manifest-only edit. The baseline run must exit nonzero, and the post-edit run must exit zero.

tasks.title: Add Shohin manifest node test
tasks.failing_test: Create a node:test regression that reads the Shohin manifest after task 001 and asserts the closed storage sqlitePath schema. The file is absent at the target baseline, so task-gate's create boundary proves it is introduced by this task.
tasks.change:
**File:** `plugins/shohin/manifest.test.mjs`

Create a node:test module using `node:assert/strict` and `node:fs` to parse `plugins/shohin/openclaw.plugin.json`. Assert that `configSchema.properties.storage.type` is `object`, `configSchema.properties.storage.additionalProperties` is `false`, the storage schema exposes only `sqlitePath`, and `configSchema.properties.storage.properties.sqlitePath.type` is `string`.
tasks.allowed_moves: Test-file creation only. Do not edit the Shohin manifest or any other product file in this task.
tasks.stop_triggers: Stop if task 002 touches anything except `plugins/shohin/manifest.test.mjs`, if it does not depend on task 001, or if `node --test plugins/shohin/manifest.test.mjs` is not green after creation.
tasks.manual_verification: Run `node --test plugins/shohin/manifest.test.mjs` after task 002 creates the file and confirm the commit file set contains only the new test file.
